orca.note: OrcaRouter (orcarouter.ai). Model ids as returned by GET /v1/models, e.g. obsidian/Qwen3.8-27B. Uses the OpenAI wire via the local shim: the router's Anthropic wire ignores every thinking-off switch for large prompts (verified 2026-08-20), and only chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false on /v1/chat/completions actually stops Qwen reasoning.
